scope: 13s scheduler recovery, terminal persistence order, overlapping whole-table writes
Policy skips, daily caps, manual runs, failure counters and trip semantics
Existing scheduler-crash e2e cold-process workers and isolated fixtures

findings.finding: Unregistered catch-up lost after recovery advances the durable due
Task table clears marker before terminal receipt commits
findings.resolution: Commit terminal row before applying settlement

findings.finding: Another whole-table save can persist prematurely mutated live state
findings.resolution: Compute a pure patch and apply only after terminal persistence

findings.finding: Empty-runId skip/cap can duplicate or execute after midnight
findings.resolution: Recover durable nonmanual skipped occurrences by occurrenceKey

findings.finding: Tick skip advances schedule before durable skip receipt
findings.resolution: Append skip first, then advance current schedule

findings.finding: Precomputed settlement overwrites concurrent schedule/counter reset
findings.resolution: Recompute settlement from current task state after append; notices reflect current trip state

findings.finding: Terminal time differs between normal settlement and reconstruction
Normal skip receipt leaves stale task result/mode

receiptSemantics: tripped records the threshold observed at completion; an explicit user reset during terminal persistence can keep the task enabled. Current state and notices use the post-append counters.
